args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

The implementation imported and used ROUND_HALF_UP, but the tests
(tests/test_money.py) and FIN-212 require banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN). Switch to the correct rounding mode.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using ROUND_HALF_UP.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switched `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the FIN-212 spec and the test expectations (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
